svg.title: Declare what you know - the generator picks the bits: the fields of a telemetry Sample, what each declaration says about its values, and what each costs on the wire
svg.desc: Eight fields of class Sample. A TimeSpanDef window of the last ~28 hours costs 3 bytes; a MinMax(-40, 125) temperature 1 byte, sent as value + 40; a MinMax(0, 100) percentage 7 bits; a four-value enum 2 bits; a bool 1 bit - the bit fields are packed together and rounded up to whole bytes; an X(1000) varint costs a length bit plus one byte within ±127; a V(30000, 0) varint a length bit plus one byte near 30 000 and two when far; an absent nullable ushort one null bit. A ribbon shows the exTernal values your code sees, the inTernal codes of the generated object and the ioT bits on the wire. The custom Unit attribute and the range become constants in C#, Java and TypeScript and never travel; MANUAL's worked Reading pack is 14 bytes after its pack id.
